summary: cheesebox gem exfiltrates installer host data to oastify.com at install time
details: The gem declares mkrf_conf.rb as a native extension in its gemspec, causing it to execute automatically during `gem install`. On execution the script reads installer-side system files (/etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf) and collects host identifiers (hostname, username, home directory, current working directory), then opens a TLS TCPSocket to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain xwx31i3e80kbj4h1s7wnh8yklbrdf33s.oastify.com on port 443 and POSTs the collected data as JSON. The destination is an attacker-controlled out-of-band interaction host, not any infrastructure related to the gem's declared purpose, and the data read is unrelated to building a native extension (no mkmf probing, no compilation of shipped sources).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
